'''Grigna''' was a rare and little-known species used as beasts of burden. Their unusually high intelligence had seen their popularity increase among beast tamers across the galaxy around the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Cartel Market">[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]]</ref>
